name: Monkey Queen
author: Abstract Games factory
description: Monkey Queen (Mark Steere, 2011): a 12x12 regicide duel between two monkey queens. Each player owns one queen -- a 20-high stack of their own checkers -- which moves and captures exactly like a chess queen, except that a NON-capturing queen move leaves its bottom checker behind as a baby monkey, so every step the queen takes costs it a checker and populates the board. Babies capture like queens too, but when not capturing they may only move to a square strictly closer, in straight-line distance, to the enemy queen. Kill the enemy queen, or leave your opponent with no legal move at all. A draw cannot occur, and the pie rule applies.
